title: ci: the affected-tests fast path never runs — the shard step compares MODE to the literal `mode=affected` while the selector writes key `mode` = `affected`, so every PR and queue build runs the full 16-shard suite (≈ 150 shard-min)
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task (CI performance programme, 2026-10-23). Reader: the `domain:ui` execution seat, dispatch step — one os-dev, one PR. Dedup: `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, "affected tests selector mode=affected never runs full suite every PR shard select-affected-tests" → 5 hits, all closed; #12214 (closed) is the two-speed CI feature this defect disables, #8861 (closed) the markdown second stage. None open. Session: `session_01GVTBi44LAWbPWg4evKfE1T`.

## One-sentence problem

objectui's CI was given a two-speed design where a pull request runs only the tests its diff can reach, but one string comparison in `ci.yml` can never be true, so the fast path has silently never executed: every PR run and every merge-queue build runs all 5,718 test files across 16 shards (≈ 150 shard-minutes, ≈ 11.5 min wall) — for a scripts-only or docs-only change as much as for a core-package change.

## Evidence (objectui commit 5fef032; runs from the GitHub Actions API, 2026-10-20/22)

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1281` — the selector step ends with `echo "$verdict" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` where `$verdict` is the literal `mode=affected` or `mode=full`; to GitHub that is output key `mode`, value `affected` / `full`.
- `:1307` — the run step reads `MODE: steps.select.outputs.mode`, i.e. the value `affected`.
- `:1310` — `if [ "$MODE" = 'mode=affected' ]; then … pnpm exec vitest run --shard=N/16 "${filters[@]}" else pnpm test --shard=N/16 …` — the condition compares `affected` with `mode=affected`, is always false, and the else branch (the full suite) always runs.
- The same two-step pattern is correct for type-check: `:756` writes `scope=affected`, `:781` reads `steps.tc-scope.outputs.scope`, `:784` compares against `'affected'` — and its notice ("Repo-root program builds …") shows that path executing.
- The only test near this, `scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts:303`, pins that the selector's stdout last line is `mode=affected`; nothing pins the output key against the compared literal.
- Measured: the `Test` aggregator's headroom notice reports total shard time 156m31s for the scripts-only merge_group run 39833395389 (PR 13329) and 155m49s for PR run 39831283561 (13327), against 140m32s for the scheduled full battery 39891005752 — the "affected" runs do more test work than the full run. Locally, `node scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --base HEAD~1 --explain` on that same diff selects 668 of 5,718 files, 8% of the timings weight.
- Replaying the selector plus `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` over main's last 40 first-parent commits: the fast set is median 69% of total weight; 4/40 commits ≤ 15% (scripts / docs / hooks), 13/40 ≈ 50% (app-shell class), 16/40 ≥ 90% (react / types / components core).
- Expected effect of the fix: ≈ −47 runner-min per CI run on average (≈ −94 per merge counting the queue build); Test lane wall 11.5 → ≈ 2–3 min for the ≤15% class, ≈ 5.5 min for the 50% class, unchanged for core-package PRs. Per-shard fixed overhead is only 35–60 s (install 5–9 s), so the saving is almost all test time.

## Governing text

- objectui#12214's acceptance (closed): "affected-only tests on PR and merge-queue runs, the full suite and coverage on main's schedule". The declared behaviour exists in the workflow text and is not enforced by it — this card restores the declaration, it adds no new behaviour.
- `scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs:13-17` header: `mode=full` runs the whole suite, `mode=affected` runs the filters in `--out`; the blind-spot list at `:42-78` and main's full push/schedule run are the safety net that was already accepted with #12214.

## Change

1. `ci.yml:1310`: compare against `'affected'` (the exact shape of `:784`). No other workflow logic changes.
2. Add one pin test (beside `select-affected-tests.test.ts`) that reads `ci.yml` and asserts: the key the selector step appends to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` is the key the run step reads from `steps.select.outputs`, and the literal the run step compares against is one of the values the selector can emit. Read, not duplicated — so a future rename breaks the test, not the fast path.
3. Re-read the `Test` aggregator's headroom logic (`check-test-shard-results` / `shard-headroom`): with ≈ 2 min of weight per leg on small PRs the "suggested width" notice will start recommending fewer shards; that is a sibling card (dynamic shard width), not this one — just make sure it does not red.

## Acceptance

- A scripts-only PR's 16 Test shards each print `Affected speed: N vitest filter(s), shard K of 16.` and the aggregator's headroom notice reports total shard time ≤ 30 min (today ≈ 156).
- A PR touching `packages/react` still reports mode full or near-full weight and stays green.
- The new pin test fails if either side of the comparison is edited alone.

## Work estimate

Lane `domain:ui` · 1 PR (.github/workflows/ci.yml one line, one new test file) · precedent: none needed — a one-line fix plus a pin; lineage #12214. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · Tier H (`.github/workflows/**` is a governed surface in objectui too — the PR waits for a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval before ready).

Prior rulings read: affected, select-affected, two-speed → objectstack docs/adr 7 hits, AGENTS.md 2 (none on this comparison); objectui thread: #12214 closed; ADR none.

Related: objectui#12214 (closed), objectui#8861 (closed), objectui#12384 (closed — shards cancelled at the 20-min limit, the symptom this fix also shrinks).

## Maintainer directive (verbatim, untranslated)

> 同意，立卡

— the maintainer, 2026-10-23, in reply to the director seat's offer 「(a) 我按 PM 流程把 A1–A5、B1–B3 立成卡进队列(英文卡面、带 Governing text: 与工作量列),由 os-dev 派发」. The CI performance analysis those letters index is the seat's 2026-10-23 five-line audit (objectstack ci.yml + lint.yml; the other 39 workflows; the repo-side turbo/vitest/gate configuration; objectui's 28 workflows; GitHub Actions run data for the preceding 5–55 hours). The maintainer's stated goal, verbatim: 「我希望优化的是性能和效率速度」.
